title: Prepare and review the enabled CodeBuild signer Terraform plan
expected_outcome: A non-secret, reproducible enabled-signer plan input and offline plan evidence are reviewed, with live-state plan requirements and no-apply boundary made explicit.
constraints: Do not run Terraform apply, access AWS, Vault, EKS, or secrets, or enable a deployed signer.
Use synthetic non-secret values only for offline validation.
Do not claim the offline plan is a live-state deployment plan.

primary_owner.responsibility: Terraform security boundary and plan-review integration

acceptance_checks: identify enabled signer inputs and offline-plan limits
delegations.escalation_trigger: live AWS state, credentials, or unknown subnet IDs are required
